211. Orgal's Negotiation (3)
Orgal stared at Phaelito without giving a reply.
[Orgal, why are you so surprised? I understand that you were the one who received the best seal from Lord Zito.]
[I can't help but be surprised, you were the one who resisted Zito the most in the past.]
[Ah, those days. But as I fought against Lord Zito, I realized something. Strictly speaking, it wasn’t a fight, but I was able to survive thanks to Lord Zito’s favor.]
[What did you realize?]

[That the order of the Sun God is not as attractive as it seems. A complete world where everything is predetermined, doesn’t it seem boring in hindsight? That's why the Sun God also met his death. What we had to do was not to resurrect him, but to create a new order.]
Orgal knew better than anyone what Zito's desired 'new order' was.
Violence and pain.

Zito was a character that perfectly aligned with the image of the demon king, demon god, and ruler of hell, as humans often describe. He believed that only violence and pain can maintain the order and balance of the world, and even be a form of amusement.
Naturally, most of the demons at that time did not agree with Zito's ideology. But Zito used his overwhelming power to slaughter those who resisted him in an instant, seizing power.
Phaelito, standing before him now, was the de facto leader of the anti-Zito faction back then.
Orgal couldn't help but be quite shocked by his apostasy.
'If Phaelito has turned to Zito... it means that there are hardly any opponents against Zito in the underworld...!'
He also had a clue why Zito had woken up so abruptly. If the entire demon realm was following Zito, a lot of manpower must have been invested to awaken his consciousness.

'But what was the reason for Zito's high influence? When he and Ameris fell asleep, peace definitely returned to the underworld. Most of those who followed Zito must have also fallen, so why is this happening? Could it be that Phaelito rallied the remaining followers to make this happen?'
Phaelito smiled as if he had seen through Orgal's inner thoughts.
[You seem to not understand why Lord Zito could be resurrected. And that fact... it seems you are not very pleased.]
Orgal went on high alert.
[It's a pity. Lord Zito cherishes you more than anyone... yet you are rejecting him.]
[I had no idea you had a taste for enjoying pain.]

[I simply think that the world needs a new order. How do you see the world above? Probably not much different from the underworld. Full of all kinds of injustices, aren't there overflowing inferior beings that can't escape their fate? We're just trying to purify those and make the world flow correctly.]
Phaelito had defected, and it was almost certain that he was under Zito's rule. Orgal could only hope that the remaining anti-Zito forces in the underworld were still meaningful.
[I understand your intentions, so it wasn't a pointless visit. I will take my leave now, Phaelito. I'm sure we will meet again soon.]
[Hold on, Orgal. I never allowed you to leave.]
Swoosh...
A huge sword formed in Phaelito's hand. The condensed purple magic radiated, pushing away the darkness in an instant.
[...Permission?]
Orgal also slowly drew his sword.

[Since you're rejecting Lord Zito's will, you've just become my enemy. Are you really ready to reject the chance to follow Lord Zito and eventually become the emperor of the demon world, the world? Lord Zito still wants you.]
[If I had wanted such glory and power, I would not have resisted Zito with you.]
[You still haven't let go of the vain dream of the Sun God.]

[Shut up, Phaelito. The only way for the world to be whole is just that. Violence and fear? Many leaders have pursued such simple methods. They have never succeeded once because it is fundamentally an incomplete method.]

[You can't compare an inferior human to the king of the demon world, Orgal. Now I see, you were the one who put Lord Zito to sleep. If it weren't for you, we would have created paradise on Earth by now.]
[Phaelito, there's only one thing I want to ask.]
[A request... not a very fitting expression, but let's hear it. What is it?]

[Non-interference. Those who live in the underworld should live only in the underworld, and those who live on the ground should live only on the ground. If this obvious condition is not accepted, it's war.]
[Ha ha...!]
Phaelito laughed so hard his waist buckled. Then, he quickly wiped the expression off his face and swung his sword.
[First, you need to feel pain. Until your mind clears.]
Slash-!
Phaelito's sword grazed Orgal's cheek. Orgal also reacted in that instant, leaving a scar on Phaelito's shoulder.
'The Demon Sword Vascaline, huh.'
Vascaline, a memory he had forgotten, came to mind.
It was once Orgal's sword. It was a sword made directly by Zito through the power of the Sun God in the past, it had the ability to seal the special abilities of the opponent.
For example, it blocks abilities such as divine power through a contract or super-regeneration. Orgal felt that the wound on his cheek was not healing.
[The sword that Lord Zito made for you, Vascaline. It's truly regrettable to cut you with this.]
[The fact that you have Vascaline means that Zito has chosen a new successor.]
[Well, I'm the one who wants that. Lord Zito said you should be helped to hold this sword again.]
[If it's a gift, as many as you like.]
[Your jokes have increased.]
Orgal did not actively respond to Phaelito's attacks.
It was not the right time to fight him. If he was seriously injured now, even the threat of the humans would be burdensome, even before Zito's return fully began.
[Ho ho, you've grown a lot. You dare think you can handle me, Phaelito, with such an attitude? Have you really achieved that much on the surface?]
Sword Devil.
This was a nickname for Phaelito in the underworld. There was no one among the demons who could surpass Phaelito in terms of the sword.
[Compared to you in those days, it's unbelievable. Seeing you handle this speed with ease. You must have had no shortage to lead the dwindling demons.]
The fight itself was not heavily tipping in Phaelito's favor.
The problem was Vascaline, the demon sword's power was suppressing Orgal's ability. While Orgal's wounds were not healing at all, Phaelito's wounds were healing before blood even flowed.
Other abilities, including the power of steel, were also blocked by Vascaline's suppression. The only means for Orgal to oppose Phaelito was purely swordsmanship.
Although it was transcendental level.
In Phaelito's eyes, it was still an incomplete sword.

[Well, I'll give you credit. Lord Zito didn't choose you as a successor for your power. The fact that you, who were just a low-ranking demon, have become this strong, is certainly a surprise. It's an area that can only be achieved by transcending fate several times.]
Gush-!
Phaelito's sword energy left a grotesque mark on the ground. If he hadn't avoided it, his body would have been torn into several pieces.
But Orgal was thinking of the cracks in the seal wall before his own body. Every time his sword clashed with Phaelito's, it seemed to affect the cracks in the seal wall bit by bit.
[Don't worry about the seal wall. If it could be broken to this extent, you wouldn't have had to come this far.]
[Finally, some good news to hear.]

[But I am slowly reaching the limit of my patience. You've lost a lot of your senses dealing with the riffraff, Orgal. I am an opponent you cannot beat even if you give your all. The old ways of giving the sword some leeway are over.]
Phaelito's eyes emitted a purple glow.
And the moment he met his eyes, Orgal had to feel the pain of his eyes being sliced. It wasn't Vascaline, but Phaelito's will that had sliced his eyes.
'My eyes...!'
Since super-regeneration couldn't be activated, his sight couldn't return. Orgal had to fight the remaining battle with only his senses.

While the realms of mind and sword were long gone, and his combat abilities wouldn't decrease as much as his abilities had been sealed, Orgal already felt the gap. He was acutely aware that he could never beat Phaelito in this state.
[Ho ho... A red sword, huh? You keep surprising me, you do. That you have such a precious power.]
Phaelito spoke, confirming the red aura on Orgal's sword. The aura was similar to the Crimson Moon that Luna had used when she fought Andrei in the past.
Phaelito cautiously pressured Orgal, showing caution for the first time.
[No, it occurs to me that it must have been this sword that made you able to put Lord Zito to sleep. Were you hiding your power then too?]

Orgal did not answer, but withstood the incoming sword strikes from Phaelito. He had no strength to answer. Due to Vascaline's suppression becoming stronger than before, even breathing became hard for Orgal.
If all his abilities were blocked, he would inevitably face death, even if he did not suffer another fatal wound.
[Orgal, it seems to be over now.]
In the end, Phaelito avoided all the final red blades displayed by Orgal and pierced his abdomen with his hand.
[Cough...]
If he had been stabbed with Vascaline instead of his hand, he would have died instantly. Barely conscious, Orgal glared at Phaelito.
There was not a single means left to resist.
'Damn, so emptily... Our great cause. Can my vice-leader continue after me... against the monsters of the surface and the underworld.'
But Phaelito did not intend to kill Orgal now.

[This much should make you regret your arrogance for daring to wage war against the Demon World. Orgal, do not dare oppose Lord Zito if you can't even handle me. Become Lord Zito's successor again, and contribute to establishing a new order.]
Phaelito threw Orgal onto the ground.
[Lord Zito's mercy is vast, but it is not eternal. I hope you make the right choice sooner rather than later, before Lord Zito's mercy turns into anger...]
